records.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE standalone photorealistic rehabilitation demonstration photograph, no collage, no text, no arrows, no numbers or watermark. Image references 1–3 define the exact same East Asian adult woman, natural skin tone and body build, white short sleeve T-shirt, dark charcoal full-length trousers, dark ponytail; preserve the original soft studio photographic style and original pale grey-blue backdrop color. This is action 022 E-LOW-008, step 01, seated ankle neutral posture.
Close side view of her RIGHT lower leg and bare right foot. She is sitting steadily on a chair outside the left edge. The knee and calf extend horizontally from the left towards the right, supported comfortably on a simple stable grey upholstered support. Include the knee area in charcoal trousers and the full lower leg, ankle, heel, whole forefoot and all toes, with adequate margin. Her trousers end neatly just above the ankle. The calf rests on the padded support, whose right edge ends BEFORE the ankle so the ankle and entire bare foot are freely suspended well above the floor. Her right foot is neutral at approximately 90 degrees to the horizontal shin, toes directed vertically upward, heel below the ankle, sole facing screen-right, toes relaxed. True lateral camera angle perpendicular to the sagittal ankle movement plane. Natural anatomically correct adult foot proportions, five relaxed toes, continuous ankle and heel. The supported calf does not touch the floor; no shoe, no hand on the foot. Keep the whole foot in frame. Background and floor are the same muted pale grey-blue as the reference photographs, with soft natural shadows. Portrait canvas with 4:5 aspect ratio, high resolution. This is the first frame of a fixed-camera three-image set; choose a clear simple close-up composition that can be held constant.
records.pose_review: 自然中间位：小腿由灰色凳面支持，裸足、踝、足跟、前足悬空；同组侧面机位。
